concept.title: Neon Fog Infiltration
concept.logline: On fog-bound, hopeful Orhaven, you slip past the watchers to recover the brass keys and restore the Founders' Statue.
concept.source_prompt: Fog City. city streets fog foggy stealth Stealth infiltration
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Old Square and becomes the one who brings the Founders' Statue back to life.

characters.name: Mayor Lyra
characters.description: Waits in Old Square and knows why the Founders' Statue fell silent.

characters.name: Juno the Courier
characters.description: Follows you from Old Square and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Patrol Drone
characters.description: A patrol drone that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.description: A patrol drone that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.description: A checkpoint drone that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Maren the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Orhaven for anything shiny.

characters.name: Street Cat
characters.description: A harmless street cat that bolts if you come too close.

actions.value: On fog-bound, hopeful Orhaven, you slip past the watchers to recover the brass keys and restore the Founders' Statue.
Heavy sentinels guard every site and they hit hard. Keep your distance.
In the Fog Wharf. Unseen, for now.
In the Botanic Garden. Unseen, for now.
In the Burnt Warehouse. Unseen, for now.
Spotted! Break line of sight and get clear.
Signal planted. You were never here.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: So you've come to Old Square at last. I am Mayor Lyra. On fog-bound, hopeful Orhaven, you slip past the watchers to recover the brass keys and restore the Founders' Statue.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: Back again. Old Square is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: Go to Fog Wharf, then Botanic Garden. Whatever still remembers Neon Fog Infiltration is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Old Square, Neon Fog Infiltration was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Noir, even then.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: Fog Wharf: Fog Wharf: a dock on the way out from Old Square.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Neon Fog Infiltration back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Mayor Lyra
nodes.text: Botanic Garden: Botanic Garden: a grove on the way out from Old Square.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Courier
nodes.text: Juno the Courier circles your feet, then looks toward Fog Wharf as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Courier
nodes.text: Juno the Courier keeps close and glances back at Old Square.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Courier
nodes.text: It turns toward Fog Wharf. Fog Wharf: a dock on the way out from Old Square.

nodes.speaker: Patrol Drone
nodes.text: Halt. Patrol Drone, of the watch at Old Square. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Patrol Drone
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Patrol Drone
nodes.text: Patrol Drone patrolling a fixed loop. Worst near Fog Wharf.

nodes.speaker: Patrol Drone 2
nodes.text: Halt. Patrol Drone 2, of the watch at Old Square. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Patrol Drone 2

nodes.speaker: Patrol Drone 2
nodes.text: Patrol Drone patrolling a fixed loop. Worst near Fog Wharf.

nodes.speaker: Checkpoint Drone
nodes.text: Halt. Checkpoint Drone, of the watch at Old Square. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Checkpoint Drone
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Checkpoint Drone
nodes.text: Patrol Drone patrolling a fixed loop. Worst near Fog Wharf.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Old Square. Maren the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Neon Fog Infiltration that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Founders' Statue after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Street Cat
nodes.text: The street cat freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
